title.zh: 卷一百三十四 列傳第七十二: 外國上 西夏
title.raw: 卷一百三十四 列傳第七十二: 外國上 西夏 Volume 134 Biographies 72: Foreign Countries 1 - Xixia

sentences.zh: 列傳第七十二 外國上 ○西夏

translations.literal: Biographies 72, Foreign Countries (Upper) ○ Western Xia
translations.idiomatic: Biography 72, Foreign Countries, Part One: Western Xia

sentences.zh: 夏國王李乾順。

translations.literal: The king of the Xia state was Li Qianshun.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Xia was Li Qianshun.

sentences.zh: 其先曰托跋思恭，唐僖宗時，為夏、綏、銀、宥節度使，與李茂貞、李克用等破黃巢，複京師，賜姓李氏。

translations.literal: His ancestor was called Tuoba Sigong. In the time of Emperor Xizong of Tang, he served as military commissioner of Xia, Sui, Yin, and You, and together with Li Maozhen, Li Keyong, and others broke Huang Chao, recovered the capital, and was granted the surname Li.
translations.idiomatic: His forebear was Tuoba Sigong, who under Tang Emperor Xizong held the posts of commissioner over the Xia, Sui, Yin, and You circuits; he joined Li Maozhen, Li Keyong, and others in crushing Huang Chao, restoring the capital, and was given the imperial surname Li.

sentences.zh: 唐末，天下大亂，籓鎮連兵，惟夏州未嘗為唐患。

translations.literal: At the end of the Tang, the realm fell into great disorder and the frontier commanderies fought one another in succession, but Xia Prefecture alone never became a trouble to the Tang.
translations.idiomatic: In the closing years of the Tang the empire dissolved into chaos and the military governors warred endlessly, yet Xia Prefecture alone never troubled the Tang court.

sentences.zh: 曆五代至宋，傳數世至元昊，始稱帝。

translations.literal: Passing through the Five Dynasties to the Song, after several generations the line reached Yuanhao, who first styled himself emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Through the Five Dynasties and into the Song the line passed down for generations until Yuanhao, who was the first to proclaim himself emperor.

sentences.zh: 遼人以公主下嫁李氏，世修朝貢不絕，事具《遼史》。

translations.literal: The Liao people sent a princess to marry into the Li family; generation after generation they maintained tribute missions without cease—the matter is recorded in full in the Liaoshi.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao married a princess to the Li house, and for generations they never ceased their tribute missions; the full account appears in the History of Liao.

sentences.zh: 天輔六年，金破遼兵，遼主走陰山，夏將李良輔將兵三萬來救遼，次天德境野穀。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tianfu, the Jin defeated Liao troops; the Liao sovereign fled to the Yin Mountains. The Xia general Li Liangfu led thirty thousand men to rescue the Liao and encamped at Yegu on the Tiande frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianfu year 6 the Jin routed the Liao army and the Liao ruler fled toward the Yin Mountains; the Xia general Li Liangfu marched thirty thousand troops to the Liao's aid and halted at Yegu in the Tiande borderlands.

sentences.zh: 斡魯、婁室敗之于宜水，追至野谷，澗水暴至，漂沒者不可勝計。

translations.literal: Wolu and Loushi defeated them at Yishui and pursued them to Yegu; the brook waters rose suddenly and those swept away and drowned were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Wolu and Loushi routed them at Yishui and chased them to Yegu, where a flash flood drowned countless men.

sentences.zh: 宗望至陰山，以便宜與夏國議和，其書曰：「奉詔有之：夏王，遼之自出，不渝終始，危難相救。

translations.literal: Zongwang reached the Yin Mountains and, acting at his discretion, negotiated peace with the Xia state. His letter said: "By imperial decree: King of Xia, born of the Liao line, you have never wavered from first to last and have aided one another in peril."
translations.idiomatic: Zongwang reached the Yin Mountains and, on his own authority, opened peace talks with Xia. His letter read: "By imperial command: King of Xia, you spring from the Liao line and have stood firm through every trial, aiding one another in times of danger."

sentences.zh: 今茲已舉遼國，若能如事遼之日以效職貢，當聽其來，毋致疑貳。

translations.literal: Now that the Liao state has been taken in hand, if you can render service and tribute as in the days when you served the Liao, we shall permit your coming and will not breed suspicion or disloyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Now that we have moved against the Liao, if you render tribute and service as you once did for them, your envoys will be received and no distrust sown.

sentences.zh: 若遼主至彼，可令執送。

translations.literal: If the Liao sovereign should come to your territory, you may have him seized and sent over.
translations.idiomatic: Should the Liao ruler flee to your lands, seize him and deliver him up.

sentences.zh: 」天會二年，始奉誓表，以事遼之禮稱籓，請受割賜之地。

translations.literal: " In the second year of Tianhui, they first submitted a sworn memorial, styled themselves a vassal with the etiquette used toward the Liao, and requested to receive the allotted granted lands.
translations.idiomatic: " In Tianhui year 2 they first submitted a sworn memorial, acknowledged vassal status under the same protocol they had used toward the Liao, and asked to receive the lands the court would grant them.

sentences.zh: 宗翰承制，割下寨以北、陰山以南、乙室耶刮部吐祿濼之西，以賜之。

translations.literal: Zonghan received the imperial commission and allotted to them the territory north of Xiazhai, south of the Yin Mountains, and west of the Tulu Bo of the Yishiye Gua tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Acting on imperial authority, Zonghan granted them the lands north of Xiazhai, south of the Yin Mountains, and west of the Tulu Bo of the Yishiye Gua tribe.

sentences.zh: 天會二年三月，乾順遣把裏公亮等來上誓表，曰：「臣乾順言：今月十五日，西南、西北兩路都統遣左諫議大夫王介儒等齎牒奉宣，若夏國追悔前非，捕送遼主，立盟上表，仍依遼國舊制及賜誓詔，將來或有不虞，交相救援者。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of Tianhui, Qianshun sent Baligong Liang and others to submit the sworn memorial, saying: "Your subject Qianshun states: On the fifteenth of this month the commanders-in-chief of the Southwest and Northwest routes dispatched the Left Remonstrance Grandee Wang Jieru and others bearing documents to proclaim that if the Xia state repents its former errors, captures and sends the Liao sovereign, establishes a covenant and submits a memorial, and still follows the old Liao regulations and the bestowed sworn edict, then whenever unforeseen troubles arise in future they shall rescue one another."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Tianhui year 2, Qianshun sent Baligong Liang and others with the sworn memorial, which read: "Your subject Qianshun reports: On the fifteenth of this month the Southwest and Northwest commanders-in-chief sent the Left Remonstrance Grandee Wang Jieru and others with orders stating that if Xia repents its past misconduct, delivers the Liao ruler, enters a sworn alliance by memorial, and continues under the former Liao protocol and the sworn edict bestowed upon us, then whenever trouble arises hereafter we shall aid each other."

sentences.zh: 臣與遼國世通姻契，名系籓臣，輒為援以啟端，曾犯威而結釁。

translations.literal: Your subject had for generations intermarried with the Liao and was registered as a vassal, yet rashly took their side to open hostilities and once offended your majesty and forged enmity.
translations.idiomatic: We had been bound to the Liao by marriage for generations and stood registered as their vassal, yet I rashly took their part and opened hostilities, offending your majesty and inviting war.

sentences.zh: 既速違天之咎，果罹敗績之憂。

translations.literal: Having quickly incurred the guilt of defying Heaven, I indeed suffered the distress of defeat.
translations.idiomatic: I soon reaped the punishment of defying Heaven's mandate and suffered crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 蒙降德音以寬前罪，仍賜土地用廣籓籬，載惟含垢之恩，常切戴天之望。

translations.literal: I was favored with a gracious edict to pardon my former crimes and was further granted lands to broaden my frontier barrier; I bear deeply in mind this grace of swallowing disgrace and constantly cherish the hope of repaying Heaven's kindness.
translations.idiomatic: Your gracious edict pardoned my former crimes and granted lands to widen our frontier; I cherish this mercy that overlooked our faults and ever hold in mind my debt to your majesty.

sentences.zh: 自今已後，凡于歲時朝賀、貢進表章、使人往復等事，一切永依臣事遼國舊例。

translations.literal: From this time forward, in all matters of seasonal court congratulations, tribute memorials, and envoys coming and going, everything shall forever follow the old precedent of a subject serving the Liao state.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, in all seasonal audiences, tribute memorials, and exchange of envoys, we shall forever follow the protocol we observed as vassals of the Liao.

sentences.zh: 其契丹昏主今不在臣境，至如奔竄到此，不復存泊，即當執獻。

translations.literal: That benighted Khitan sovereign is not now within your subject's borders; should he flee and stray here, he shall not be harbored but shall at once be seized and presented.
translations.idiomatic: The benighted Khitan ruler is not within our borders now; should he flee here, we shall not shelter him but seize him and deliver him up at once.

sentences.zh: 若大朝知其所在，以兵追捕，無敢為地及依前援助。

translations.literal: If the Great Court knows where he is and sends troops in pursuit, we dare not give him refuge or aid him as before.
translations.idiomatic: If the Great Court learns his whereabouts and sends troops in pursuit, we shall neither harbor him nor aid him as we did before.

sentences.zh: 其或徵兵，即當依應。

translations.literal: If troops are requisitioned, we shall respond at once.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever troops are called up, we shall answer the summons.

sentences.zh: 至如殊方異域朝覲天闕，合經當國道路，亦不阻節。

translations.literal: As for distant lands and foreign realms paying court at the celestial gate, those who should pass through our country's roads shall not be obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from distant realms bound for your court who must travel through our lands shall not be impeded.

sentences.zh: 以上所敘數事，臣誓固此誠，傳嗣不變，苟或有渝，天地鑒察，神明殛之，禍及子孫，不克享國。

translations.literal: In all the matters set forth above, your subject swears to hold firm to this sincerity and pass it unchanged to his heirs; if there should be any breach, may Heaven and Earth witness, the spirits strike us down, calamity reach our descendants, and we fail to keep our state.
translations.idiomatic: In all the matters set forth above I swear this faith unbroken for my heirs; should we violate it, may Heaven and Earth bear witness, the spirits strike us down, calamity fall on our descendants, and our line lose the throne.

sentences.zh: 」所謂西北，西南兩路都統者宗翰也。

translations.literal: " The so-called commanders-in-chief of the Northwest and Southwest routes were Zonghan.
translations.idiomatic: " The Southwest and Northwest commanders-in-chief referred to here were Zonghan.

sentences.zh: 蓋宗望以太祖命與之通書，而宗翰以便宜割地議和雲。

translations.literal: For Zongwang, by the Taizu Emperor's command, exchanged letters with them, while Zonghan, acting at his discretion, ceded territory to negotiate peace.
translations.idiomatic: Zongwang had opened correspondence with them on the Taizu Emperor's orders, while Zonghan had ceded territory and made peace on his own authority.

sentences.zh: 太宗使王阿海、楊天吉往賜誓詔曰：「維天會二年歲次甲辰，閏三月戊寅朔，皇帝賜誓詔于夏國王乾順：先皇帝誕膺駿命，肇啟鴻圖，而卿國據夏台，境連遼右，以效力於昏主，致結釁于王師。

translations.literal: The Taizong Emperor sent Wang Ahai and Yang Tianji to bestow the sworn edict, which said: "In the second year of Tianhui, the year jiachen, on the first day of the intercalary third month, wuyin, the Emperor bestows this sworn edict upon the King of Xia, Qianshun: The former emperor received the grand mandate and opened the great enterprise, while your state held Xia Terrace and bordered the Liao on the right, yet served that benighted sovereign and brought enmity upon the imperial armies."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong sent Wang Ahai and Yang Tianji to deliver the sworn edict, which read: "In Tianhui year 2, the year jiachen, on the first day of the intercalary third month, wuyin, the Emperor bestows this sworn edict upon King Qianshun of Xia: The late emperor received Heaven's grand mandate and founded our great enterprise, while your realm held Xia Terrace and bordered the Liao, yet you served that benighted ruler and brought war upon our armies."

sentences.zh: 先皇帝以謂忠於所事，務施恩而釋過，迨眇躬之纂紹，仰遺訓以遵行，卿乃深念前非，樂從內附，飭使軺而奉貢，效臣節以稱籓。

translations.literal: The former emperor held that loyalty to one's lord deserves grace and pardon; now that my humble person has succeeded to the throne, I look up to his testament and follow it. You have deeply reflected on your former errors, gladly submitted to inner allegiance, ordered your envoys to bring tribute, and shown subject's duty in styling yourself a vassal.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor held that loyalty to one's lord deserved mercy; now that I have succeeded the throne I follow his testament. You have deeply repented your past errors, gladly submitted to our rule, sent envoys with tribute, and performed the duties of a vassal.

sentences.zh: 載錫寵光，用彰複好，所有割賜地土、使聘禮節、相為援助等事，一切恭依先朝制詔。

translations.literal: Favor and glory are hereby bestowed to manifest renewed amity; in all matters of allotted granted lands, envoy protocol, and mutual aid, everything shall respectfully follow the former court's regulations and edicts.
translations.idiomatic: We bestow favor and glory to renew our friendship; in all matters of granted lands, diplomatic protocol, and mutual aid, you shall follow the regulations and edicts of the former reign.

sentences.zh: 其依應徵兵，所請宜允。

translations.literal: Your request to answer when troops are requisitioned is fittingly granted.
translations.idiomatic: Your request to answer when troops are called up is granted.

sentences.zh: 三辰在上，朕豈食言，苟或變渝，亦如卿誓。

translations.literal: With sun, moon, and stars above as witness, how could We break Our word? If there should be any change or breach, it shall be as in your oath.
translations.idiomatic: With sun, moon, and stars as witness, how could We break Our word? Should We violate this pact, let the same penalties fall on Us as in your oath.

sentences.zh: 遠垂戒諭，毋替厥誠。」

translations.literal: Though you dwell afar, heed this admonition and do not slacken your sincerity."
translations.idiomatic: Though you dwell far away, heed this admonition and do not slacken your loyalty."

sentences.zh: 於是，宋人與夏人俱受山西地，宋人侵取之，乾順遣使表謝賜誓詔、並論宋所侵地。

translations.literal: Thereupon both the Song and the Xia received Shanxi lands; the Song encroached and seized them. Qianshun sent envoys with a memorial thanking them for the bestowed sworn edict and also addressing the lands the Song had seized.
translations.idiomatic: Both the Song and Xia had received Shanxi territory, but the Song encroached upon it; Qianshun sent envoys to thank the court for the sworn edict and to protest the Song seizures.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「省所上表，具悉，已命西南、西北兩路都統府從宜定奪。

translations.literal: An edict said: "We have reviewed your submitted memorial and understand it fully; the Southwest and Northwest commanders-in-chief's offices have been ordered to decide as circumstances require."
translations.idiomatic: An edict replied: "We have read your memorial and understand it; the Southwest and Northwest commanders-in-chief are ordered to decide the matter as circumstances require."

sentences.zh: 」是時，宗翰朝京師未還，錄夏國奏付權都統斡魯，宋人侵略新受疆土、及使人王阿海爭儀物事，與夏通問以便宜決之。

translations.literal: " At that time Zonghan had not yet returned from audience at the capital; the Xia memorial was copied and sent to the acting commander-in-chief Wolu, with orders that the Song encroachment on newly received territory and the dispute over protocol gifts with the envoy Wang Ahai be settled through communication with the Xia as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: " Zonghan had not yet returned from the capital; the Xia memorial was forwarded to Acting Commander-in-Chief Wolu with orders to settle, as circumstances required, both the Song encroachment on newly granted territory and the dispute over protocol gifts with envoy Wang Ahai through negotiations with Xia.

sentences.zh: 初，以山西九州與宋人，而天德遠在一隅，緩急不可及，割以與夏。

translations.literal: At first the nine prefectures of Shanxi were given to the Song, but Tiande lay far in a corner where urgent needs could not be met in time, so it was ceded to the Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the nine Shanxi prefectures were granted to the Song, but Tiande lay too remote for timely aid in emergencies, so that region was ceded to Xia instead.

sentences.zh: 後破宋都獲二帝，乃畫陝西分界，自麟府路洛陽溝東距黃河西岸、西曆暖泉堡，鄜延路米脂穀至累勝寨，環慶路威邊寨過九星原至委布穀口，涇原路威川寨略古蕭關至北谷川，秦鳳路通懷堡至古會州，自此直距黃河，依見今流行分熙河路盡西邊以限封域。

translations.literal: Later, after the Song capital was taken and the two emperors captured, the Shaanxi boundary was drawn: from Luoyang Gully in Qinfu Circuit east to the west bank of the Yellow River and west through Nuanquan Fort; from Mizhi Valley in Fuyan Circuit to Leisheng Stockade; from Weibian Stockade in Huanqing Circuit across Jiuxing Plain to Weibu Valley mouth; from Weichuan Stockade in Jingyuan Circuit past the ancient Xia Pass to Beigu Valley; from Tonghuai Fort in Qinfeng Circuit to ancient Huizhou; thence straight to the Yellow River, and following present practice the entire western border of Xihe Circuit was divided to delimit the realm.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jin captured the Song capital and took the two emperors, they drew the Shaanxi border: from Luoyang Gully in Qinfu east to the Yellow River's west bank and west through Nuanquan Fort; from Mizhi Valley in Fuyan to Leisheng Stockade; from Weibian in Huanqing across Jiuxing Plain to Weibu Valley; from Weichuan in Jingyuan past the ancient Xia Pass to Beigu Valley; from Tonghuai in Qinfeng to ancient Huizhou; thence straight to the Yellow River, and along present practice the entire western Xihe circuit was partitioned to fix the frontier.

sentences.zh: 複分陝西北鄙以易天德、雲內，以河為界。

translations.literal: Further, the northern marches of Shaanxi were allotted in exchange for Tiande and Yunnei, with the river as boundary.
translations.idiomatic: The northern marches of Shaanxi were then exchanged for Tiande and Yunnei, with the river as the boundary.

sentences.zh: 及婁室定陝西，婆盧火率兵先取威戎城。

translations.literal: When Loushi pacified Shaanxi, Poluhuo led troops first to take Weirong city.
translations.idiomatic: When Loushi secured Shaanxi, Poluhuo led the vanguard to capture Weirong.

sentences.zh: 軍至威戎東與敵遇，擊走之，生致二人，問之，乃知為夏將李遇取威戎也，乃還其人而與李遇通問。

translations.literal: The army reached the east of Weirong and met the enemy, routed them, and took two men alive; on questioning them they learned that the Xia general Li Yu had taken Weirong, so they returned the men and opened communication with Li Yu.
translations.idiomatic: East of Weirong they met the enemy, routed them, and took two prisoners; questioning revealed that the Xia general Li Yu had seized Weirong, so they released the men and opened talks with Li Yu.

sentences.zh: 李遇軍威戎西，蒲察軍威戎東，而使使議事于婁室。

translations.literal: Li Yu's army was west of Weirong and Pucha's army east of Weirong, and they sent envoys to discuss matters with Loushi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu held Weirong's west and Pucha its east, and both sides sent envoys to confer with Loushi.

sentences.zh: 婁室報曰：「元帥府約束，若兵近夏境，則與夏人相為掎角，毋相侵犯。

translations.literal: Loushi replied: "The Marshal's headquarters has ordered that when troops approach the Xia border, they and the Xia shall support each other in pincer fashion and shall not encroach on one another."
translations.idiomatic: Loushi replied: "Marshal headquarters has ordered that when our armies approach the Xia border we shall coordinate with them and not encroach on one another."

sentences.zh: 」李遇使人來曰：「夏國既以天德、雲內歸大國，大國許我陝西北鄙之地，是以至此。

translations.literal: " Li Yu sent a man who said: "Since the Xia state has returned Tiande and Yunnei to the Great State, and the Great State granted us the northern marches of Shaanxi, we have come here for that reason."
translations.idiomatic: " Li Yu's envoy said: "Xia has returned Tiande and Yunnei to the Great State, and the Great State granted us the northern marches of Shaanxi—that is why we are here."

sentences.zh: 」蒲察等遂旋軍。

translations.literal: " Pucha and the others thereupon withdrew their army.
translations.idiomatic: " Pucha and his forces then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 睿宗既定陝西，元帥府不欲以陝西北鄙與夏國，詔曰：「卿等審處所宜從事。」

translations.literal: After Emperor Ruizong had pacified Shaanxi, the Marshal's headquarters did not wish to give the northern marches of Shaanxi to the Xia state; an edict said: "You are to consider and act as circumstances require."
translations.idiomatic: Once Emperor Ruizong had secured Shaanxi, marshal headquarters was reluctant to yield the northern marches to Xia; an edict instructed them to "consider the matter and act as circumstances require."

sentences.zh: 天眷二年，國王乾順薨，子仁孝立，遣使冊命，加開府儀同三司上柱國。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianjuan, King Qianshun died and his son Renxiao succeeded; envoys were sent to invest him, and he was given the additional titles of Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Supreme Pillar of State.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianjuan year 2 King Qianshun died and his son Renxiao succeeded; the court sent envoys to invest him and added the titles of Honorary Palace Secretary of the First Rank and Supreme Pillar of State.

sentences.zh: 皇統元年，請置榷場、許之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangtong they requested establishment of a trade market and permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangtong year 1 they requested a trade market and the court approved it.

sentences.zh: 初，王阿海等乙太宗誓詔賜夏國，乾順以契丹舊儀見使者，阿海不肯曰：「契丹與夏國甥舅也，故國王坐受，使者以禮進。

translations.literal: At first, when Wang Ahai and others brought the Taizong Emperor's sworn edict to bestow upon the Xia state, Qianshun received the envoys by the old Khitan protocol. Ahai refused, saying: "The Khitan and the Xia state are uncle and nephew by marriage, so the former king sat to receive while the envoy advanced with ceremony."
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Ahai and others first delivered Emperor Taizong's sworn edict to Xia, Qianshun received them by the old Khitan protocol. Ahai objected: "The Khitan and Xia were marriage kin, so your king could sit while the envoy performed the full ceremony."

sentences.zh: 今大金與夏國君臣也，見大國使者當如儀。

translations.literal: Now the Great Jin and the Xia state are sovereign and subject; in receiving envoys of the Great State you must follow the proper protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Great Jin and Xia are sovereign and subject; in receiving envoys of the Great State you must follow the proper protocol.

sentences.zh: 」爭數日不能決，於是始起立受焉。

translations.literal: " They disputed for several days without resolution, and only then did he first rise to his feet to receive it.
translations.idiomatic: " They disputed for days without resolution, and only then did the king rise to receive the edict.

sentences.zh: 厥後不遣賜生日使，至是始遣使賜之。

translations.literal: Afterward they had not sent birthday-congratulation envoys; only now were envoys first dispatched to bestow gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the court had not sent birthday-congratulation envoys; only now were they first dispatched.

sentences.zh: 初，慕洧以環州降，及割陝西、河南與宋人，洧奔夏國，夏人以為山訛首領。

translations.literal: At first Mu Wei surrendered Huan Prefecture; when Shaanxi and Henan were ceded to the Song, Wei fled to the Xia state and the Xia made him a Shan'e chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Wei had first surrendered Huan Prefecture to the Jin; when Shaanxi and Henan were ceded to the Song he fled to Xia, which made him a Shan'e chieftain.

sentences.zh: 及撒離喝再定陝西，洧思歸，夏人知之，遂族洧，以表聞，詔書責讓之。

translations.literal: When Salihua again pacified Shaanxi, Wei wished to return; the Xia learned of it and thereupon exterminated Wei's clan and reported by memorial; an edict rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: When Salihua reconquered Shaanxi, Wei sought to return; learning of this, the Xia exterminated his clan and reported the matter; the court sent a rebuking edict.

sentences.zh: 及海陵弑熙宗，遣使報諭至境上，夏人問曰：「聖德皇帝何為見廢。

translations.literal: When Hailing assassinated Emperor Xizong and sent envoys to announce the change at the border, the Xia asked: "Why was the Sagely Virtue Emperor deposed?"
translations.idiomatic: When Hailing murdered Emperor Xizong and sent envoys to announce the change at the border, the Xia asked: "Why was the Sagely Virtue Emperor deposed?"

sentences.zh: 」不肯納。

translations.literal: " They refused to receive the envoys.
translations.idiomatic: " They refused to admit the envoys.

sentences.zh: 朝廷乃使有司以廢立之故移文報之。

translations.literal: The court then had the responsible offices send a written report on the reasons for the deposition and enthronement.
translations.idiomatic: The court then had the responsible offices send a written explanation of the deposition and succession.

sentences.zh: 天德二年七月，夏使御史中丞雜辣公濟等來賀，如舊禮。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Tiande, the Xia envoy Censor-in-Chief Zala Gongji and others came to offer congratulations according to the old protocol.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Tiande year 2 the Xia envoy, Censor-in-Chief Zala Gongji, and others came to offer congratulations under the former protocol.

sentences.zh: 久之，其臣任得敬專國政，欲分割夏國。

translations.literal: After a long time his minister Ren Dedejing monopolized state affairs and wished to partition the Xia state.
translations.idiomatic: In time his minister Ren Dedejing seized control of government and sought to partition Xia.

sentences.zh: 因賀大定八年正旦，遣奏告使殿前太尉芭裏昌祖等以仁孝章乞良醫為得敬治疾，詔保全郎王師道佩銀牌往焉。

translations.literal: On the occasion of congratulating the New Year's Day of the eighth year of Dading, they sent memorial-reporting envoys, Palace Commander Balichangzu and others, with a memorial from Renxiao requesting a skilled physician to treat Dedejing's illness; an edict ordered Preservation Officer Wang Shidao, bearing a silver tablet, to go.
translations.idiomatic: On congratulating the New Year of Dading year 8 they sent memorial envoys, Palace Commander Balichangzu and others, with Renxiao's memorial requesting a skilled physician for Dedejing; the court ordered Preservation Officer Wang Shidao, bearing a silver tablet, to go.

sentences.zh: 詔師道曰：「如病勢不可療，則勿治。

translations.literal: An edict told Shidao: "If the illness cannot be treated, then do not treat it."
translations.idiomatic: The edict instructed Shidao: "If the illness is beyond cure, do not treat it."

sentences.zh: 如可治，期一月歸。

translations.literal: If it can be treated, set a term of one month to return."
translations.idiomatic: If it can be treated, return within one month."

sentences.zh: 」得敬疾有瘳，遣謝恩使任得聰來，得敬亦附表進禮物，上曰：「得敬自有定分，附表禮物皆不可受。

translations.literal: " When Dedejing's illness improved somewhat, they sent a gratitude envoy, Ren Decong, and Dedejing also attached a memorial presenting gifts. The emperor said: "Dedejing has his own allotted fate; the attached memorial and gifts must none of them be accepted."
translations.idiomatic: " When Dedejing recovered somewhat, they sent gratitude envoy Ren Decong; Dedejing also attached a memorial with gifts. The emperor said: "Dedejing has his allotted fate; neither the memorial nor the gifts may be accepted."

sentences.zh: 」並卻之。

translations.literal: " All were refused.
translations.idiomatic: " All were refused.

sentences.zh: 初，仁孝嗣位，其臣屢作亂，任得敬抗禦有功，遂相夏二十餘年，陰蓄異志，欲圖夏國，誣殺宗親大臣，其勢漸逼，仁孝不能制。

translations.literal: At first, when Renxiao succeeded to the throne, his ministers repeatedly rebelled; Ren Dedejing had merit in resisting them and thus served as Xia chancellor for more than twenty years, secretly harboring divergent aims and plotting against the Xia state, falsely executing imperial kin and great ministers until his power gradually pressed upon the king and Renxiao could not control him.
translations.idiomatic: When Renxiao first succeeded, his ministers rebelled repeatedly; Ren Dedejing had distinguished himself in suppressing them and served as chancellor for more than twenty years, secretly plotting to seize Xia, framing and executing royal kin and senior ministers until his power overwhelmed the throne and Renxiao could not restrain him.

sentences.zh: 大定十年，乃分西南路及靈州羅龐嶺地與得敬，自為國，且上表為得敬求封。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Dading he partitioned off the Southwest Route and the Luopang Ridge lands of Ling Prefecture to Dedejing, who established his own state, and moreover submitted a memorial requesting enfeoffment for Dedejing.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading year 10 he ceded the Southwest Route and the Luopang Ridge region of Lingzhou to Dedejing, who proclaimed a separate state and memorialized the Jin court to enfeoff him.

sentences.zh: 世宗以問宰相，尚書令李石等曰：「事系彼國，我何預焉，不如因而許之。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizong asked the chief ministers; Minister of Works Li Shi and others said: "The matter concerns their state—what have we to do with it? Better to grant it accordingly."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong consulted his chief ministers; Minister of Works Li Shi and others said: "This is their internal affair—why should we intervene? Better to grant the request."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「有國之主豈肯無故分國與人，此必權臣逼奪，非夏王本意。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Would the lord of a state willingly partition his realm for no reason? This must be a powerful minister forcing seizure—it cannot be the Xia king's true intent."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor replied: "Would any sovereign willingly cede territory for no reason? A powerful minister must be forcing this—it cannot reflect the Xia king's true intent."

sentences.zh: 況夏國稱籓歲久，一旦迫於賊臣，朕為四海主，甯容此邪？

translations.literal: Moreover, the Xia state has styled itself a vassal for many years; to be suddenly forced by a treacherous minister—We are lord of the four seas; how could We tolerate this?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Xia has been our vassal for many years; to be suddenly coerced by a traitorous minister—We are lord of all under Heaven; how could We tolerate this?

sentences.zh: 若彼不能自正，則當以兵誅之，不可許也。

translations.literal: If they cannot set themselves right, then We shall punish him with troops; it cannot be granted.
translations.idiomatic: If they cannot set this right themselves, We shall send troops to punish the traitor; the request cannot be granted.

sentences.zh: 」乃卻其貢物，賜仁孝詔曰：「自我國家戡定中原，懷柔西土，始則畫疆于乃父，繼而錫命於爾躬，恩厚一方，年垂三紀，籓臣之禮既務踐修，先業所傳亦當固守。

translations.literal: " Thereupon their tribute gifts were refused, and an edict was bestowed upon Renxiao, saying: "Since Our state pacified the Central Plain and embraced the western lands, We first drew boundaries for your father and then bestowed investiture upon your person; grace has been deep in your region for nearly three decades; vassal ritual should be diligently practiced, and the patrimony handed down should be firmly held."
translations.idiomatic: " The court refused their tribute and sent Renxiao an edict: "Since Our state pacified the Central Plain and embraced the western lands, We first drew your father's borders and then invested you; Our grace has rested on your realm for nearly thirty years; you should diligently observe vassal protocol and firmly hold the patrimony you inherited."

sentences.zh: 今茲請命，事頗靡常，未知措意之由來，續當遣使以詢爾。

translations.literal: This present request is quite irregular; We do not know the source of your intent and shall later send envoys to inquire of you.
translations.idiomatic: Your present request is highly irregular; We do not know what prompted it and shall send envoys to inquire.

sentences.zh: 所有貢物，已令發回。」

translations.literal: All tribute goods have been ordered sent back."
translations.idiomatic: All tribute goods have been ordered returned."

sentences.zh: 得敬密通宋人求助，宋以蠟丸書答得敬，夏人得之。

translations.literal: Dedejing secretly communicated with the Song to seek aid; the Song answered Dedejing with a wax-sealed letter, which the Xia obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Dedejing secretly sought Song aid; the Song replied with a wax-sealed letter that the Xia intercepted.

sentences.zh: 得敬始因求醫附表進禮物，欲以嘗試世宗，既不可行，而求封又不可得，仁孝乃謀誅之。

translations.literal: Dedejing had first, under the pretext of seeking a physician, attached a memorial presenting gifts to test Emperor Shizong; when that could not succeed and enfeoffment also could not be obtained, Renxiao then plotted to execute him.
translations.idiomatic: Dedejing had first used the medical mission to present gifts and test Emperor Shizong; when that failed and enfeoffment was denied, Renxiao plotted his execution.

sentences.zh: 八月晦，仁孝誅得敬及其黨與，上表謝，並以所執宋人及蠟丸書來上。

translations.literal: On the last day of the eighth month, Renxiao executed Dedejing and his faction, submitted a memorial of thanks, and also presented the captured Song men and the wax-sealed letter.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the eighth month Renxiao executed Dedejing and his faction, submitted a memorial of thanks, and presented the captured Song agents and the wax-sealed letter.

sentences.zh: 其謝表曰：「得敬初受分土之後，曾遣使赴大朝代求封建，蒙詔書不為俞納，此朝廷憐愛之恩，夏國不勝感戴。

translations.literal: The memorial of thanks said: "After Dedejing first received his allotted lands, he once sent envoys to the Great Court to request enfeoffment; We received an edict refusing approval—this was the court's compassionate grace, for which the Xia state is deeply grateful beyond measure."
translations.idiomatic: The memorial of thanks read: "After Dedejing received his allotted lands he once sent envoys to request enfeoffment; your edict refused approval—this was the court's compassionate grace, for which Xia is profoundly grateful."

sentences.zh: 夏國妄煩朝廷，冒求賊臣封建，深虧禮節。

translations.literal: The Xia state rashly troubled the court and presumptuously sought enfeoffment for a treacherous minister, deeply violating ritual propriety.
translations.idiomatic: Xia rashly troubled the court by presumptuously seeking enfeoffment for a traitor, gravely violating protocol.

sentences.zh: 今既賊臣誅訖，大朝不用遣使詢問。

translations.literal: Now that the treacherous minister has been executed, the Great Court need not send envoys to inquire.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the traitor has been executed, the Great Court need not send envoys to inquire.

sentences.zh: 得敬所分之地與大朝熙秦路接境，恐自分地以來別有生事，已根勘禁約，乞朝廷亦行禁約。」

translations.literal: The lands Dedejing partitioned off border the Great Court's Xi-Qin Route; fearing that since the partition other troubles may arise, We have thoroughly investigated and imposed prohibitions, and beg the court also to impose prohibitions."
translations.idiomatic: Dedejing's allotted lands border the court's Xi-Qin Route; fearing further trouble since the partition, we have investigated and imposed restrictions, and beg the court to do the same."

sentences.zh: 十二年，上謂宰臣曰：「夏國以珠玉易我絲帛，是以無用易我有用也。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the emperor told the chief ministers: "The Xia state exchanges pearls and jade for Our silk and cloth—that is trading the useless for the useful."
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 the emperor told his ministers: "Xia trades pearls and jade for our silk and cloth—they exchange the useless for the useful."

sentences.zh: 」乃減罷保安、蘭州榷場。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the trade markets at Bao'an and Lanzhou were reduced and abolished.
translations.idiomatic: " The court then reduced and closed the trade markets at Bao'an and Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 仁孝深念世宗恩厚，十七年，獻本國所造百頭帳，上曰：「夏國貢獻自有方物，可卻之。

translations.literal: Renxiao deeply remembered Emperor Shizong's generous grace; in the seventeenth year he presented a hundred-head tent made in his state. The emperor said: "The Xia state's tribute has its established goods; this may be refused."
translations.idiomatic: Deeply mindful of Emperor Shizong's grace, in year 17 Renxiao presented a hundred-head tent made in Xia. The emperor said: "Xia's tribute has its established categories; this may be refused."

sentences.zh: 」仁孝再以表上曰：「所進帳本非珍異，使人亦已到邊，若不蒙包納，則下國深誠無所展效，四方鄰國以為夏國不預大朝眷愛之數，將何所安。

translations.literal: " Renxiao again submitted a memorial, saying: "The tent presented is not in itself rare or extraordinary, and the envoys have already reached the border; if it is not graciously accepted, then our lower state has no way to display its deep sincerity, and the neighboring states on all sides will think the Xia state is not counted among those the Great Court favors—how could we find security?"
translations.idiomatic: " Renxiao submitted another memorial: "The tent presented is not especially rare, and our envoys have already reached the border; if it is not accepted, our sincerity cannot be shown, and neighboring states will think Xia is not among those the Great Court favors—how could we find security?"

sentences.zh: 」乃許與正旦使同來。

translations.literal: " Permission was then granted for it to come together with the New Year's envoys.
translations.idiomatic: " Permission was granted for it to arrive with the New Year's envoys.

sentences.zh: 明昌四年，仁孝薨，子純佑嗣立。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Mingchang, Renxiao died and his son Chunyou succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In Mingchang year 4 Renxiao died and his son Chunyou succeeded.

sentences.zh: 承安二年，複置蘭州、保安榷場。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chengan the trade markets at Lanzhou and Bao'an were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In Chengan year 2 the trade markets at Lanzhou and Bao'an were re-established.

sentences.zh: 承安五年，純佑母病風求醫，詔太醫判官時德元及王利貞往，仍賜禦藥。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chengan, Chunyou's mother fell ill with wind-stroke and sought a physician; an edict ordered Imperial Medical Commissioner Shideyuan and Wang Lizhen to go, and imperial medicine was also bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In Chengan year 5 Chunyou's mother suffered a stroke and requested a physician; the court sent Imperial Medical Commissioner Shideyuan and Wang Lizhen and bestowed imperial medicine.

sentences.zh: 八月，再賜醫藥。

translations.literal: In the eighth month medicine was again bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month medicine was sent again.

sentences.zh: 泰和六年三月，仁孝弟仁友子安全，廢純佑自立，再閱月死於廢所。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year of Taihe, Renxiao's younger brother Renyou's son Anquan deposed Chunyou and established himself; after another month Chunyou died in the place of his deposition.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Taihe year 6 Renxiao's nephew Anquan, son of Renyou, deposed Chunyou and seized the throne; a month later Chunyou died in confinement.

sentences.zh: 七月，使純佑母羅氏為表，言純佑不能嗣守，與大臣定議立安全為王，遣使奏告。

translations.literal: In the seventh month they had Chunyou's mother Lady Luo submit a memorial stating that Chunyou could not succeed and hold the throne, that she and the great ministers had settled on establishing Anquan as king, and envoys were sent to report.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Chunyou's mother Lady Luo submitted a memorial stating that Chunyou could not hold the throne, that she and the senior ministers had agreed to install Anquan as king, and envoys were dispatched to report the change.

sentences.zh: 夏使私問館伴官：「奏告事詔許否？

translations.literal: The Xia envoy privately asked the hosting officer: "Has the memorial report been approved by edict?"
translations.idiomatic: The Xia envoy privately asked the hosting officer: "Has the memorial report been approved?"

sentences.zh: 」館伴官曰：「此不當問也。

translations.literal: " The hosting officer said: "That is not a question you should ask."
translations.idiomatic: " The hosting officer replied: "That is not a question you should ask."

sentences.zh: 」夏使曰：「明日當問諸客省，若又不答，則升殿奏請。

translations.literal: " The Xia envoy said: "Tomorrow I shall ask the Guest Reception Office; if they again do not answer, I shall ascend the hall and petition."
translations.idiomatic: " The Xia envoy said: "Tomorrow I shall ask the Guest Reception Office; if they refuse again, I shall petition at court."

sentences.zh: 」上聞之，使客省諭以許所祈之意，乃賜羅氏詔詢其意，夏人複以羅氏表來，乃封安全為夏國王。

translations.literal: " When the emperor heard of it, he had the Guest Reception Office inform them that their request was granted, then bestowed an edict upon Lady Luo inquiring her intent; the Xia again sent Lady Luo's memorial, and Anquan was enfeoffed as King of Xia.
translations.idiomatic: " When the emperor heard this, he had the Guest Reception Office inform them that their request was granted, then sent Lady Luo an edict inquiring her intent; when the Xia sent her memorial again, Anquan was enfeoffed as King of Xia.

sentences.zh: 崇慶元年三月，攻葭州。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Chongqing they attacked Jia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Chongqing year 1 they attacked Jia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至甯元年六月，攻保安州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Zhining they attacked Bao'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Zhining year 1 they attacked Bao'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 貞祐元年十一月，攻會州，都統徒單醜兒擊走之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Zhenyou they attacked Huizhou; Commander-in-Chief Tushan Chou'er routed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Zhenyou year 1 they attacked Huizhou; Commander-in-Chief Tushan Chou'er routed them.

sentences.zh: 十二月，陷涇州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month they took Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month they captured Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，歸國人喬成齎夏國書，大概言金邊吏侵略，乞禁戢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year the returned subject Qiao Cheng brought a letter from the Xia state, stating in general that Jin frontier officials were encroaching and begging that it be forbidden and restrained.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 2 the repatriated subject Qiao Cheng brought a Xia letter protesting Jin frontier encroachments and begging the court to restrain them.

sentences.zh: 詔移文答之，宰臣言：「既非公牒，今將責問，彼必飾詞，徒為虛文，無益於事。

translations.literal: An edict was drafted in reply; the chief ministers said: "Since it is not an official document, if We now rebuke them they will surely dress up their words—it would be empty formality with no benefit to the affair."
translations.idiomatic: An edict was drafted in reply; the ministers said: "Since this is not an official document, if we rebuke them they will only dress up their words—empty formality that would accomplish nothing."

sentences.zh: 」乃止。

translations.literal: " The matter was then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: " The matter was dropped.

sentences.zh: 未幾，夏人攻慶原、延安、積石州，乃詔有司移文責問。

translations.literal: Before long the Xia attacked Qingyuan, Yan'an, and Jishi Prefecture; an edict then ordered the responsible offices to send written rebukes.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Xia forces attacked Qingyuan, Yan'an, and Jishi; the court ordered the responsible offices to send written rebukes.

sentences.zh: 十一月，蘭州譯人程陳僧結夏人以州叛，邊將敗其兵三千。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Lanzhou interpreter Cheng Chenseng joined with the Xia to rebel with the prefecture; frontier generals defeated three thousand of their troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Lanzhou interpreter Cheng Chenseng colluded with Xia to rebel with the prefecture; frontier generals routed three thousand of their troops.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，夏兵攻武延川，宣宗曰：「此不足慮，恐由他道入也。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year Xia troops attacked Wuyan River; Emperor Xuanzong said: "This is not worth worrying over—they probably fear entry by another route."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 3 Xia troops attacked Wuyan River; Emperor Xuanzong said: "This is no great concern—they likely fear we will enter by another route."

sentences.zh: 」既而聞邊吏侵夏境，夏人乃攻環州，詔治邊吏罪。

translations.literal: " Soon afterward it was learned that frontier officials had encroached on Xia territory; the Xia then attacked Huan Prefecture, and an edict ordered punishment of the frontier officials.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon afterward it emerged that frontier officials had encroached on Xia territory; the Xia then attacked Huan Prefecture, and the court ordered the offending officials punished.

sentences.zh: 夏兵攻積石州，都統姜伯通敗之。

translations.literal: Xia troops attacked Jishi Prefecture; Commander-in-Chief Jiang Botong defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Xia troops attacked Jishi Prefecture; Commander-in-Chief Jiang Botong routed them.

sentences.zh: 夏兵入安鄉關，都統曹記僧、萬戶忽三十卻之。

translations.literal: Xia troops entered Anxiang Pass; Commander-in-Chief Cao Jiseng and Commander of Ten Thousand Hu Sanshi repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: Xia troops entered Anxiang Pass; Commander-in-Chief Cao Jiseng and Commander of Ten Thousand Hu Sanshi drove them back.

sentences.zh: 二月，攻環州，刺史烏古論延壽敗之於境上。

translations.literal: In the second month they attacked Huan Prefecture; Prefect Wugulun Yanshou defeated them on the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month they attacked Huan Prefecture; Prefect Wugulun Yanshou routed them at the border.

sentences.zh: 三月，詔議伐夏，陝西宣撫司奏：「往者，夏人侵我環、慶，河、蘭、積石以兵應之，悉皆遁去，遽還巢穴，蓋為我備也。

translations.literal: In the third month an edict ordered discussion of campaigning against Xia; the Shaanxi Pacification Commission memorialized: "In the past, when the Xia invaded our Huan and Qing, He, Lan, and Jishi responded with troops, they all fled away and swiftly returned to their lairs—this was because they were on guard against us."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the court debated a campaign against Xia; the Shaanxi Pacification Commission reported: "When Xia previously invaded our Huan and Qing circuits, our forces at He, Lan, and Jishi responded and they all fled straight back to their lairs—they were clearly on guard against us."

sentences.zh: 今蘭州潰兵猶未集，軍實多不完，沿邊地寒，春草始生，未可芻牧，兩界無煙火者三百餘裏，不宜輕舉。

translations.literal: Now the routed troops at Lanzhou are not yet gathered, military stores are largely incomplete, the frontier lands are cold, spring grass has only begun to grow and cannot yet be cut for fodder, and for more than three hundred li on both sides there is no sign of habitation—it is not fitting to act rashly.
translations.idiomatic: Lanzhou's routed troops are not yet reassembled, supplies are incomplete, the frontier is still cold, spring grass has only just sprouted and cannot yet feed herds, and for more than three hundred li along both borders there is no habitation—a rash move would be unwise.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was accepted.
translations.idiomatic: " The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 四月，詔河州提控曹記僧、通遠軍節度使完顏狗兒討程陳僧，夏人援之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month an edict ordered Hezhou Controller Cao Jiseng and Tongyuan Army Military Commissioner Wanyan Gou'er to suppress Cheng Chenseng; the Xia came to his aid.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the court ordered Hezhou Controller Cao Jiseng and Tongyuan Army Commissioner Wanyan Gou'er to suppress Cheng Chenseng; Xia sent reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 九月，遂破西關堡。

translations.literal: In the ninth month they then took Xiguan Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month they captured Xiguan Fort.

sentences.zh: 夏人複攻第五將城，萬戶楊再興擊走之。

translations.literal: The Xia again attacked the Fifth Commandery city; Commander of Ten Thousand Yang Zaixing routed them.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia again attacked the Fifth Commandery city; Commander of Ten Thousand Yang Zaixing drove them off.

sentences.zh: 詔陝西宣撫司及沿邊諸將，降空名宣敕，臨陣立功，五品以下並聽遷授。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Shaanxi Pacification Commission and all frontier generals to issue blank-name edicts of appointment: those who achieved merit in battle below the fifth rank might all be promoted.
translations.idiomatic: The court authorized the Shaanxi Pacification Commission and frontier generals to issue blank appointment edicts, permitting promotion below the fifth rank for merit in battle.

sentences.zh: 十月，攻保安及延安，都統完顏國家奴破之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month they attacked Bao'an and Yan'an; Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Guojianu defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month they attacked Bao'an and Yan'an; Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Guojianu routed them.

sentences.zh: 既而深入臨洮，總管陀滿胡土門不能禦，陝西宣撫副使完顏胡失來救臨洮，大敗於渭源堡，城破，胡失來被執。

translations.literal: They then pushed deep into Lintao; Commander Tuoman Hutumen could not withstand them. Shaanxi Pacification Vice Commissioner Wanyan Hushilai came to rescue Lintao but was utterly defeated at Weiyuan Fort; the city fell and Hushilai was captured.
translations.idiomatic: They then drove deep into Lintao; Commander Tuoman Hutumen could not hold them. Shaanxi Pacification Vice Commissioner Wanyan Hushilai marched to relieve Lintao but was crushed at Weiyuan Fort; the city fell and Hushilai was taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 十一月，夏兵敗於克戎寨，複敗於熟羊寨，宰相入賀，宣宗曰：「此忠賢之力也。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Xia troops were defeated at Kerong Stockade and again at Shuyang Stockade; the chief ministers entered to congratulate, and Emperor Xuanzong said: "This is the power of the loyal and worthy."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Xia forces were defeated at Kerong and again at Shuyang stockades; when the chief ministers came to congratulate, Emperor Xuanzong said: "This is the work of our loyal servants."

sentences.zh: 」夏兵進圍臨洮，陀滿胡土門破之。

translations.literal: " Xia troops advanced to besiege Lintao; Tuoman Hutumen defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: " Xia forces advanced to besiege Lintao; Tuoman Hutumen routed them.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，夏葩俄族總管汪三郎率眾來降，進羊千口，詔納之，優給其直。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year the Xiapao tribal commander Wang Sanlang led his people to surrender and presented a thousand sheep; an edict accepted them and generously paid their price.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 4 the Xiapao tribal commander Wang Sanlang surrendered with his followers and presented a thousand sheep; the court accepted them and paid generously.

sentences.zh: 來遠鎮獲諜人，言宋、夏相結來攻，詔陝西行省備之。

translations.literal: At Laiyuan town a spy was captured who said the Song and Xia had joined to attack; an edict ordered the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat to prepare.
translations.idiomatic: At Laiyuan a spy was captured reporting a Song-Xia alliance to attack; the court ordered the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat to prepare.

sentences.zh: 夏於來羌城界河起折橋，元帥右都監完顏賽不焚之，斬馘甚眾。

translations.literal: The Xia built a folding bridge across the border river at Laiqiang city; Marshal Right Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Saibu burned it and killed a great many.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia built a pontoon bridge across the border river at Laiqiang; Marshal Right Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Saibu burned it and killed many.

sentences.zh: 六月，鄜延路奏，夏人牒報用彼國光定年號，詔封還其牒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Fuyan Circuit reported that Xia documents used their state's Guangding reign title; an edict ordered the documents sealed and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Fuyan Circuit reported that Xia documents used their Guangding reign title; the court ordered the documents sealed and returned.

sentences.zh: 閏月，慶陽總管慶山奴伐夏，出環州，陝西行省請中分其軍，令慶山奴出第三將懷安寨，環州刺史完顏胡魯出環州，宣宗曰：「聞夏人移軍備其王城，尚恐詐我，勿墮其計中也。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month Qingyang Commander Qingshannu campaigned against Xia, setting out from Huan Prefecture; the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat requested splitting his army, ordering Qingshannu out from the Third Commandery's Huai'an Stockade and Huan Prefect Wanyan Hulu out from Huan Prefecture. Emperor Xuanzong said: "I hear the Xia have shifted troops to guard their royal city—we still fear they may be deceiving us; do not fall into their trap."
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Qingyang Commander Qingshannu campaigned against Xia from Huan Prefecture; the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat asked to split his force, with Qingshannu from Huai'an Stockade and Huan Prefect Wanyan Hulu from Huan. Emperor Xuanzong said: "I hear the Xia are shifting troops to guard their capital—we may still be deceived; do not fall into their trap."

sentences.zh: 」提控完顏狗兒抵蘭州西關堡，招得舊部曲九人。

translations.literal: " Controller Wanyan Gou'er reached Lanzhou's Xiguan Fort and recruited nine of his former retainers.
translations.idiomatic: " Controller Wanyan Gou'er reached Lanzhou's Xiguan Fort and recruited nine former retainers.

sentences.zh: 掩擊夏兵于阿彌灣，殺其將士百餘人。

translations.literal: He ambushed Xia troops at Ami Bay and killed more than a hundred officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: He ambushed Xia forces at Ami Bay and killed more than a hundred officers and men.

sentences.zh: 八月，左監軍烏古論慶壽敗夏兵于安塞堡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Left Supervisor Wugulun Qingshou defeated Xia troops at Ansai Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Left Supervisor Wugulun Qingshou routed Xia forces at Ansai Fort.

sentences.zh: 右都監賽不擊走夏兵於結耶觜川，複破之于車兒堡。

translations.literal: Right Commander-in-Chief Saibu routed Xia troops at Jieyezui River and again defeated them at Che'er Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Right Commander-in-Chief Saibu drove off Xia forces at Jieyezui River and defeated them again at Che'er Fort.

sentences.zh: 十一月，提控石盞合喜、楊斡烈解定西之圍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Controllers Shizhan Hexi and Yang Walie lifted the siege of Dingxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Controllers Shizhan Hexi and Yang Walie lifted the siege of Dingxi.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，宣宗與皇太子議伐夏，左監軍陀滿胡土門、延安總管古裏甲石倫攻鹽、宥、夏州，慶陽總管慶山奴、知平涼府移剌答不也攻威、靈、安、會等州。

translations.literal: On bingyin of the twelfth month Emperor Xuanzong and the Crown Prince discussed campaigning against Xia: Left Supervisor Tuoman Hutumen and Yan'an Commander Gurijia Shilun were to attack Yan, You, and Xia Prefectures; Qingyang Commander Qingshannu and Pingliang Prefect Yila Dabuye were to attack Wei, Ling, An, and Hui Prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the twelfth month Emperor Xuanzong and the Crown Prince planned a Xia campaign: Left Supervisor Tuoman Hutumen and Yan'an Commander Gurijia Shilun would attack Yan, You, and Xia; Qingyang Commander Qingshannu and Pingliang Prefect Yila Dabuye would attack Wei, Ling, An, and Hui.

sentences.zh: 興定元年正月，夏兵三萬自寧州還，慶山奴以兵邀擊，敗之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Xingding, thirty thousand Xia troops returned from Ning Prefecture; Qingshannu intercepted them with troops and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Xingding year 1 thirty thousand Xia troops withdrew from Ning Prefecture; Qingshannu intercepted and routed them.

sentences.zh: 詔河東行省胥鼎選兵三萬五千，付陀滿胡土門伐夏，鼎馳奏不可，遂止，語在鼎傳。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Hedong Branch Secretariat Xudin to select thirty-five thousand troops and hand them to Tuoman Hutumen to campaign against Xia; Ding urgently memorialized that it could not be done and the matter was stopped—the account is in Ding's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Hedong Branch Secretariat Xudin to select thirty-five thousand troops for Tuoman Hutumen's Xia campaign; Ding urgently memorialized against it and the plan was halted—the account appears in his biography.

sentences.zh: 右都監完顏仲元請試兵西夏，出其不意必獲全勝，兵威既振，國力益完。

translations.literal: Right Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Zhongyuan requested trial of troops against Western Xia, saying that catching them unawares would surely win complete victory, military prestige would be aroused, and national strength further secured.
translations.idiomatic: Right Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Zhongyuan proposed testing troops against Western Xia, arguing that a surprise attack would win complete victory, restore military prestige, and strengthen the state.

sentences.zh: 詔下尚書省、樞密院議。

translations.literal: An edict was sent down to the Ministry of Works and the Bureau of Military Affairs for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the Ministry of Works and the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 夏人福山以俘戶來降，除同知澤州軍州事。

translations.literal: The Xia subject Fushan came to surrender with captive households and was appointed Vice Commissioner of Ze Prefecture Military District.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia subject Fushan surrendered with captive households and was appointed Vice Commissioner of Ze Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月，夏兵入大北岔，都統紇石烈豬狗掩擊，敗之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Xia troops entered Dabeicha; Commander-in-Chief Heshe Lie Zhugou ambushed and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Xia forces entered Dabeicha; Commander-in-Chief Heshe Lie Zhugou ambushed and routed them.

sentences.zh: 宣宗欲與夏議和，右都監慶山奴屯延安，奏曰：「夏國決不肯和，徒見欺耳。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong wished to discuss peace with Xia; Right Commander-in-Chief Qingshannu, encamped at Yan'an, memorialized: "The Xia state will certainly not agree to peace—we would only be deceived."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong wished to negotiate peace with Xia; Right Commander-in-Chief Qingshannu, encamped at Yan'an, reported: "Xia will never agree to peace—we would only be deceived."

sentences.zh: 」既而，獲諜者言，遵頊聞大金將約和，戒諭將士無犯西鄙。

translations.literal: " Soon afterward a captured spy said that Zunxu, hearing the Great Jin was about to make peace, had admonished his officers and men not to violate the western marches.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon afterward a captured spy reported that Zunxu, hearing the Great Jin sought peace, had ordered his troops not to violate the western marches.

sentences.zh: 宰臣奏曰：「就令如此，邊備亦不宜弛。

translations.literal: The chief ministers memorialized: "Even if this is so, frontier preparations should not be relaxed."
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers reported: "Even so, frontier defenses must not be relaxed."

sentences.zh: 」宣宗以為然。

translations.literal: " Emperor Xuanzong agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " Emperor Xuanzong agreed.

sentences.zh: 右都監完顏閭山敗夏兵于黃鶴岔。

translations.literal: Right Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Lüshan defeated Xia troops at Huanghe Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Right Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Lüshan routed Xia forces at Huanghe Pass.

sentences.zh: 夏人圍羊狠寨，都統黨世昌與戰，完顏狗兒遣都統夾穀瑞夜斫夏營，遂解其圍，猶駐近地，左都監白撒發定西銳兵、龕谷副統包孝成緋翮翅軍，合擊走之。

translations.literal: The Xia besieged Yanghen Stockade; Commander-in-Chief Dang Shichang fought them. Wanyan Gou'er sent Commander-in-Chief Jiagu Rui to strike the Xia camp by night, thus lifting the siege, but they still encamped nearby; Left Commander-in-Chief Baisha sent Dingxi elite troops and Qian'gu Vice Commander Bao Xiaocheng's Crimson-Winged Army, and together they routed the Xia.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia besieged Yanghen Stockade; Commander-in-Chief Dang Shichang fought them while Wanyan Gou'er sent Jiagu Rui to raid the Xia camp by night and lift the siege. The Xia still camped nearby until Left Commander-in-Chief Baisha sent Dingxi elite troops and Bao Xiaocheng's Crimson-Winged Army from Qian'gu, which together drove them off.

sentences.zh: 八月，安定堡馬家平總押李公直敗夏兵三千。

translations.literal: In the eighth month at Anding Fort, Majiaping Chief Commandant Li Gongzhi defeated three thousand Xia troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month at Anding Fort, Chief Commandant Li Gongzhi of Majiaping routed three thousand Xia troops.

sentences.zh: 九月，都統羅世暉卻夏兵於克戎寨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Commander-in-Chief Luo Shihui repulsed Xia troops at Kerong Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Commander-in-Chief Luo Shihui repulsed Xia forces at Kerong Stockade.

sentences.zh: 興定二年三月，右都監慶山奴奏：「夏人有乞和意，保安、綏德、葭州得文報，乞複互市，以尋舊盟。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of Xingding, Right Commander-in-Chief Qingshannu memorialized: "The Xia show intent to beg peace; Bao'an, Suide, and Jia Prefectures have received written reports asking to restore mutual markets and renew the old covenant."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Xingding year 2 Right Commander-in-Chief Qingshannu reported: "Xia appear willing to sue for peace; Bao'an, Suide, and Jia have received written requests to restore trade markets and renew the old alliance."

sentences.zh: 以臣觀之，此出於遵頊，非邊吏所敢專者。

translations.literal: In your subject's view this comes from Zunxu and is not something frontier officials would dare decide on their own.
translations.idiomatic: In my view this comes from Zunxu himself, not something frontier officials would dare initiate on their own.

sentences.zh: 」朝廷不以為然。

translations.literal: " The court did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: " The court disagreed.

sentences.zh: 五月，夏人入葭州，慶山奴破之于馬吉峰。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the Xia entered Jia Prefecture; Qingshannu defeated them at Maji Peak.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Xia forces entered Jia Prefecture; Qingshannu routed them at Maji Peak.

sentences.zh: 七月，犯龕谷，夾谷瑞、趙防敗之，追至質孤堡。

translations.literal: In the seventh month they violated Qian'gu; Jiagu Rui and Zhao Fang defeated them and pursued to Zhigu Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month they attacked Qian'gu; Jiagu Rui and Zhao Fang routed them and pursued to Zhigu Fort.

sentences.zh: 三年閏月，夏人破通秦寨，提控納合買住擊敗之，自葭盧川遁去。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month of the third year the Xia took Tongqin Stockade; Controller Nahe Maizhu defeated them and they fled away along Jialu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month of year 3 the Xia captured Tongqin Stockade; Controller Nahe Maizhu defeated them and they fled along the Jialu River.

sentences.zh: 華州元帥完顏合達出安寨堡至隆州，敗其兵二千。

translations.literal: Huazhou Marshal Wanyan Heda marched from Anzhai Fort to Long Prefecture and defeated two thousand of their troops.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou Marshal Wanyan Heda marched from Anzhai Fort to Long Prefecture and routed two thousand Xia troops.

sentences.zh: 進攻隆州，克其西南，會暮乃還。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack Long Prefecture, took its southwest, and returned at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed the attack on Long Prefecture, took its southwest quarter, and withdrew at dusk.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔有司移文夏國。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month an edict ordered the responsible offices to send written communications to the Xia state.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the court ordered the responsible offices to send written communications to Xia.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，夏人犯鎮戎，金師敗績，夏人公移語不遜，詔詞臣草牒折之。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year the Xia violated Zhenrong; Jin forces suffered defeat; the Xia official communication used disrespectful language, and an edict ordered literary officials to draft a rebuking document.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 4 the Xia attacked Zhenrong and Jin forces were defeated; Xia's official communication was insolent, and the court ordered literary officials to draft a rebuking reply.

sentences.zh: 四月，夏兵犯邊，元帥石盞合喜遇于鹿兒原，提控烏古論世顯以偏師敗之，都統王定複破其眾於新泉城。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Xia troops violated the border; Marshal Shizhan Hexi met them at Lu'er Plain; Controller Wugulun Shixian with a detached force defeated them, and Commander-in-Chief Wang Ding again broke their host at Xinquan city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Xia violated the border; Marshal Shizhan Hexi met them at Lu'er Plain; Controller Wugulun Shixian routed them with a detached force, and Commander-in-Chief Wang Ding broke their main body at Xinquan.

sentences.zh: 元帥慶山奴攻宥州，圍神堆府，穴其城，士卒有登者，援兵至，擊走之，斬首二千，俘百餘人，獲雜畜三千餘。

translations.literal: Marshal Qingshannu attacked You Prefecture, besieged Shendui Prefecture, tunneled into its walls, and some soldiers mounted the ramparts; relief troops arrived and they were routed; two thousand heads were cut off, more than a hundred captured, and more than three thousand miscellaneous livestock taken.
translations.idiomatic: Marshal Qingshannu attacked You Prefecture and besieged Shendui, tunneling into its walls until some soldiers scaled the ramparts; when relief arrived he routed them, taking two thousand heads, more than a hundred prisoners, and over three thousand head of livestock.

sentences.zh: 八月，夏人陷會州，刺史烏古論世顯降，複犯龕谷，夾谷瑞連戰敗之，夏人乃去。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Xia took Huizhou; Prefect Wugulun Shixian surrendered; they again violated Qian'gu; Jiagu Rui defeated them in successive battles and the Xia then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Xia captured Huizhou and Prefect Wugulun Shixian surrendered; they again attacked Qian'gu; Jiagu Rui defeated them in successive battles and the Xia withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔有司移文議和，事竟不克。

translations.literal: That month an edict ordered the responsible offices to send written communications to discuss peace, but in the end it could not be achieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court ordered written communications to discuss peace, but negotiations failed.

sentences.zh: 夏人三萬自高峰鎮圍定西，刺史愛申阿失剌、提控烏古論長壽、溫敦永昌擊走之。

translations.literal: Thirty thousand Xia troops from Gaofeng town besieged Dingxi; Prefect Aishen Ashila and Controllers Wugulun Changshou and Wendun Yongchang routed them.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty thousand Xia troops from Gaofeng besieged Dingxi; Prefect Aishen Ashila and Controllers Wugulun Changshou and Wendun Yongchang drove them off.

sentences.zh: 九月，夏人圍綏平寨、安定堡，未幾，陷西寧州，遂攻定西，烏古論長壽擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Xia besieged Suiping Stockade and Anding Fort; before long they took Xining Prefecture, then attacked Dingxi; Wugulun Changshou repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Xia besieged Suiping Stockade and Anding Fort; soon they captured Xining and attacked Dingxi; Wugulun Changshou repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 乃襲鞏州，石盞合喜逆戰，一日十余戰，乃解去。

translations.literal: They then raided Gong Prefecture; Shizhan Hexi met them in battle; there were more than ten engagements in a single day before they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: They then raided Gong Prefecture; Shizhan Hexi met them in more than ten battles in a single day before they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，詔樞密院議夏事，奏曰：「夏人聚兵境上，欲由會州入，已遣行省白撒伏兵險要以待之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year an edict ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to deliberate on Xia affairs; they memorialized: "The Xia have massed troops on the border and intend to enter by Huizhou; the Branch Secretariat Baisha has already been sent to lay ambush in strategic passes to await them."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 5 the Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to deliberate on Xia affairs and reported: "Xia have massed troops on the border intending to enter through Huizhou; Branch Secretariat Baisha has been sent to ambush the strategic passes."

sentences.zh: 鄜延元帥府伺便發兵以綴其後，足以無慮。

translations.literal: The Fuyan Marshal's headquarters will watch for an opportunity to send troops to harass their rear—there is no cause for concern.
translations.idiomatic: The Fuyan Marshal's headquarters will strike their rear when opportunity permits—there is no cause for concern.

sentences.zh: 」二月，甯遠軍節度使夾谷海壽破夏兵於搜嵬堡。

translations.literal: " In the second month Ningyuan Army Military Commissioner Jiagu Haishou defeated Xia troops at Souwei Fort.
translations.idiomatic: " In the second month Ningyuan Army Commissioner Jiagu Haishou routed Xia forces at Souwei Fort.

sentences.zh: 三月，複取來羌城。

translations.literal: In the third month Laiqiang city was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Laiqiang was recovered.

sentences.zh: 十月，攻龕谷，白撒連敗之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month they attacked Qian'gu; Baisha defeated them in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month they attacked Qian'gu; Baisha defeated them repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 元光元年正月，夏人陷大通城，複取之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Yuanguang the Xia took Datong city; it was then recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yuanguang year 1 the Xia captured Datong; the Jin then recovered it.

sentences.zh: 三月，提控李師林敗夏兵於永木嶺。

translations.literal: In the third month Controller Li Shilin defeated Xia troops at Yongmu Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Controller Li Shilin routed Xia forces at Yongmu Ridge.

sentences.zh: 八月，攻甯安寨，十月，攻神林堡，十二月，入質孤堡，提控唐括昉敗之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month they attacked Ning'an Stockade; in the tenth month they attacked Shenlin Fort; in the twelfth month they entered Zhigu Fort; Controller Tanggu Fang defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month they attacked Ning'an Stockade; in the tenth, Shenlin Fort; in the twelfth they entered Zhigu Fort, where Controller Tanggu Fang defeated them.

sentences.zh: 二年，遵頊使其太子德任來伐，德任諫曰：「彼兵勢尚強，不若與之約和。

translations.literal: In the second year Zunxu sent his Crown Prince Deren to campaign; Deren remonstrated: "Their military strength is still formidable—it would be better to make peace with them."
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 Zunxu sent Crown Prince Deren to campaign; Deren urged: "Their forces are still strong—we should make peace instead."

sentences.zh: 」遵頊笑曰：「是非爾所知也。

translations.literal: " Zunxu laughed and said: "That is not for you to know."
translations.idiomatic: " Zunxu laughed: "That is beyond your understanding."

sentences.zh: 彼失蘭州竟不能複，何強之有。

translations.literal: They lost Lanzhou and could not even recover it—what strength do they have?
translations.idiomatic: They lost Lanzhou and could not even recover it—how strong can they be?

sentences.zh: 」德任固諫不從，乞避太子位，願為僧。

translations.literal: " Deren firmly remonstrated but was not heeded; he begged to step aside from the crown prince's position and wished to become a monk.
translations.idiomatic: " Deren pressed his advice in vain, begged to renounce the crown prince's position, and asked to become a monk.

sentences.zh: 遵頊怒，幽之靈州，遣人代將，會天旱不果。

translations.literal: Zunxu was angry, imprisoned him at Ling Prefecture, and sent another to command in his place; but drought intervened and the campaign did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Zunxu in anger imprisoned him at Lingzhou and sent another to command; drought intervened and the campaign failed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大元兵問罪夏國，延安、慶原元帥府欲乘夏人之困弊伐之，陝西行省白撒、合達以為不可，乃止。

translations.literal: That year Great Yuan troops called the Xia state to account; the Yan'an and Qingyuan Marshal's headquarters wished to take advantage of the Xia's exhaustion to campaign against them, but Shaanxi Branch Secretariat Baisha and Heda held it could not be done, and the plan was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yuan forces moved against Xia; the Yan'an and Qingyuan marshal headquarters wished to exploit Xia's weakness, but Shaanxi Branch Secretariat Baisha and Heda objected and the plan was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 隴安軍節度使完顏阿鄰日與將士宴飲，不治軍事，夏人乘之，掠民五千余口、牛羊雜畜數萬而去。

translations.literal: Long'an Army Military Commissioner Wanyan Alin daily feasted and drank with officers and men and did not attend to military affairs; the Xia seized the opportunity and carried off more than five thousand civilians and tens of thousands of cattle, sheep, and miscellaneous livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Long'an Army Commissioner Wanyan Alin spent his days feasting with his troops and neglected military affairs; the Xia seized the chance and carried off more than five thousand civilians and tens of thousands of livestock.

sentences.zh: 自天會議和，八十餘年與夏人未嘗有兵革之事。

translations.literal: From the peace concluded at Tianhui, for more than eighty years there had never been warfare with the Xia.
translations.idiomatic: From the peace concluded at Tianhui, for more than eighty years Jin and Xia had known no warfare.

sentences.zh: 及貞祐之初，小有侵掠，以至構難十年不解，一勝一負精銳皆盡，而兩國俱弊。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyou there were small encroachments and raids, leading to ten years of unresolved hostility; victory and defeat alternated until elite forces were exhausted on both sides and both states were worn down.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhenyou minor raids escalated into ten years of unbroken hostility; victories and defeats alternated until both sides' elite forces were spent and both states exhausted.

sentences.zh: 是歲，遵頊傳位於子德旺。

translations.literal: That year Zunxu transmitted the throne to his son Dewang.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zunxu abdicated in favor of his son Dewang.

sentences.zh: 正大元年，和議成，自稱兄弟之國。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengda peace was concluded and they styled themselves a nation of brothers.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengda year 1 peace was concluded and they styled themselves brother states.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，遵頊死，七月，德旺死，嗣立者史失其名。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year Zunxu died; in the seventh month Dewang died; the name of the successor is lost to history.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 3 Zunxu died; in the seventh month Dewang died; the successor's name is lost to history.

sentences.zh: 明年，夏國亡。

translations.literal: The following year the Xia state perished.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Xia fell.

sentences.zh: 先是，夏使精方匭匣使王立之來聘，未複命國已亡，詔於京兆安置，充宣差彈壓，主管夏國降戶。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Xia envoy Jingfang Box Envoy Wang Lizhi had come on a mission of courtesy; before he could report back his state had perished; an edict ordered him settled at Jingzhao, appointed Special Commissioner for Suppression, in charge of Xia surrendered households.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Xia envoy Wang Lizhi had come on a diplomatic mission; before he could report home his state had fallen; the court settled him at Jingzhao as Special Commissioner for Suppression, in charge of Xia surrendered households.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，立之妻子三十余口至環州，詔以歸立之，賜以幣帛。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year Lizhi's wife and children, more than thirty persons, reached Huan Prefecture; an edict ordered them returned to Lizhi and bestowed silks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 8 Lizhi's wife and more than thirty family members reached Huan Prefecture; the court reunited them with Lizhi and bestowed silks.

sentences.zh: 立之上言，先世本申州人，乞不仕，居申州。

translations.literal: Lizhi memorialized that his forebears were originally from Shen Prefecture and begged not to hold office but to reside at Shen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Lizhi memorialized that his ancestors were from Shen Prefecture and begged to retire from office and live there.

sentences.zh: 詔如所請，以本官居申州，主管唐、鄧、申、裕等處夏國降戶，聽唐、鄧總帥府節制，給上田千畝、牛具農作雲。

translations.literal: An edict granted his request; he was to reside at Shen Prefecture in his present office, supervising Xia surrendered households in Tang, Deng, Shen, Yu, and other places, subject to the Tang-Deng Marshal's headquarters, and granted a thousand mu of superior fields, oxen, farm implements, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted his request; he retained his title while residing at Shen, supervising Xia surrendered households in Tang, Deng, Shen, Yu, and elsewhere under the Tang-Deng marshal headquarters, with a grant of a thousand mu of superior fields, oxen, and farm implements.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：夏之立國舊矣，其臣羅世昌譜敘世次稱，元魏衰微，居松州者因以舊姓為托跋氏。

translations.literal: The encomium says: The founding of Xia is of long standing. Their minister Luo Shichang, in his genealogical account of successive generations, states that when the Northern Wei declined, those dwelling at Song Prefecture took their old surname and became the Tuoba clan.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium reads: Xia's founding dates far back. Their minister Luo Shichang, in his genealogical account, states that when the Northern Wei declined, those dwelling at Song Prefecture took the old surname Tuoba.

sentences.zh: 按《唐書》党項八部有托跋部，自党項入居銀、夏之間者號平夏部。

translations.literal: According to the Tangshu, among the eight Tangut tribes was the Tuoba tribe; those Tanguts who entered and dwelt between Yin and Xia were called the Pingxia tribe.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Tang History, among the eight Tangut tribes was the Tuoba tribe; those who settled between Yin and Xia were called the Pingxia tribe.

sentences.zh: 托跋思恭以破黃巢功賜姓李氏，兄弟相繼為節度使，居夏州，在河南。

translations.literal: Tuoba Sigong, for merit in breaking Huang Chao, was granted the surname Li; brothers succeeded one another as military commissioners, dwelling at Xia Prefecture south of the river.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoba Sigong was granted the surname Li for crushing Huang Chao; his brothers succeeded one another as military commissioners, dwelling at Xia Prefecture south of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 繼遷再立國，元昊始大，乃北渡河，城興州而都之。

translations.literal: Jiqian re-established the state; Yuanhao first made it great; he then crossed the river northward, walled Xing Prefecture, and made it his capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jiqian re-established the state; Yuanhao first made it great, then crossed the Yellow River northward, walled Xing Prefecture, and made it his capital.

sentences.zh: 其地初有夏、綏、銀、宥、靈、鹽等州，其後遂取武威、張掖、酒泉、燉煌郡地，南界橫山，東距西河，土宜三種，善水草，宜畜牧，所謂涼州畜牧甲天下者是也。

translations.literal: Their territory at first had Xia, Sui, Yin, You, Ling, Yan, and other prefectures; afterward they took the commandery lands of Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan, and Dunhuang; their southern border was Heng Mountain and their eastern limit the Western River; the soil suited the three grains, grass and water were good, and herding was suitable—the so-called Liangzhou livestock, finest under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Their territory initially comprised Xia, Sui, Yin, You, Ling, Yan, and other prefectures; later they took Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan, and Dunhuang; their southern border was Heng Mountain and their eastern limit the Western River. The soil suited grain, grass and water were abundant, and herding flourished—hence the saying that Liangzhou livestock was finest under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 土堅腴，水清冽，風氣廣莫，民俗強梗尚氣，重然諾，敢戰鬥。

translations.literal: The soil was firm and fertile, the waters clear and pure, the winds broad and desolate; the people were stubborn and prized honor, valued sworn promises, and dared to fight.
translations.idiomatic: The soil was firm and fertile, the waters clear, the winds harsh; the people were stubborn and proud, valued their word, and were fierce in battle.

sentences.zh: 自漢、唐以水利積谷食邊兵，興州有漢、唐二渠，甘、涼亦各有灌溉，土境雖小，能以富強，地勢然也。

translations.literal: From Han and Tang onward they used waterworks to store grain and feed frontier troops; Xing Prefecture had the Han and Tang canals, and Gan and Liang each had irrigation as well; though their territory was small, they could be rich and strong—such was the advantage of their terrain.
translations.idiomatic: Since Han and Tang times irrigation had stored grain to feed frontier troops; Xing had the Han and Tang canals and Gan and Liang their own irrigation works. Though their territory was small, they could be wealthy and strong—such was the advantage of their land.

sentences.zh: 五代之際，朝興夕替，制度禮樂，蕩為灰燼，唐節度使有鼓吹，故夏國聲樂清厲頓挫，猶有鼓吹之遺音焉。

translations.literal: In the age of the Five Dynasties courts rose in the morning and fell by evening; institutions, rites, and music were swept to ashes; Tang military commissioners had wind-and-percussion ensembles, so Xia music, though its clear sharp tones were abruptly checked, still preserved traces of those ensembles.
translations.idiomatic: During the Five Dynasties courts rose and fell overnight; institutions, rites, and music were reduced to ashes. Tang military commissioners had wind-and-percussion ensembles, so Xia music—though its clear, sharp tones were curtailed—still preserved traces of that tradition.

sentences.zh: 然能崇尚儒術，尊孔子以帝號，其文章辭命有可觀者。

translations.literal: Yet they were able to honor Confucian learning, esteem Confucius with an imperial title, and their documents and edicts have passages worth viewing.
translations.idiomatic: Yet they honored Confucian learning, styled Confucius with an imperial title, and produced documents and edicts of genuine merit.

sentences.zh: 立國二百餘年，抗衡遼、金、宋三國，偭鄉無常，視三國之勢強弱以為異同焉。

translations.literal: Established as a state for more than two hundred years, they contended with Liao, Jin, and Song; their orientation was inconstant, shifting with the relative strength of the three states.
translations.idiomatic: For more than two hundred years they contended with Liao, Jin, and Song, shifting allegiance according to whichever power was ascendant.

sentences.zh: 故近代學者記西北地理，往往皆臆度言之。

translations.literal: Therefore modern scholars recording the geography of the northwest often speak from mere conjecture.
translations.idiomatic: Hence modern scholars writing on northwest geography often speak from mere conjecture.

sentences.zh: 聖神有作，天下會於一，驛道往來視為東西州矣。

translations.literal: When the sage and divine arose, the realm was united as one, and courier routes running east and west made it seem but two provinces.
translations.idiomatic: When the sage emperor arose and united the realm, courier routes running east and west made the northwest seem but another province of the empire.
